proposed.text: What does Section 605.4 generally require for foundation plates, sills, and sleepers on concrete or masonry slabs in direct contact with earth?

options.text: Untreated wood if hidden from view
Any species allowed by the timber stress table
Treated wood marked or branded by an approved agency
Aluminum flashing only, with no wood treatment

rationale.correct: Section 605.4 requires treated wood, marked or branded by an approved agency, for those foundation plates, sills, sleepers, and sills on foundations, subject to stated official-approval exceptions.
